title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Suspension for Arrears, Reinstatement Window and Cancellation for Cause
content:
## Credit control note

**Suspension.** Coverage under the Preventive Maintenance Agreements is suspended once an installment stays unpaid beyond the tier's suspension period counted from the day the installment invoice fell due, counting calendar days with the due day excluded and the final day included. The due day is the one on the installment entry in the agreement's history, and an installment counts as unpaid while its invoice carries no payment entry of equal or greater amount. On a 45-day period, an installment due on 1 March reaches the end of the period on 15 April; it is still inside the period on 15 April and beyond it from 16 April.

**While suspended.** No visit is performed and no repair is absorbed, and work the owner asks for meanwhile is quoted as demand service at the published rates.

**Retired clause.** The clause "Coverage is put back in force when the arrears are settled in full and the tier's reinstatement fee is charged; the suspended term is not extended, so the visits lost while suspended are not credited back." is **no longer in force** as the basis for the reinstatement charge; it has been superseded by the current basis. The tier's reinstatement fee on the terms sheet remains a published figure of the tier.

**Reinstatement of an expired agreement.** An agreement whose term has already ended may be put back in force only inside the tier's reinstatement window counted forward from the term end date, counting calendar days with the end day excluded and the final day included; after that window a new proposal and, where the tier requires one, a fresh pre-agreement inspection are needed. The term end date is read from the agreement record.

| Term ended on (hypothetical) | Window of the tier | Last day on which reinstatement is still inside the window | First day outside it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 30 days | 30 July | 31 July |
| 30 June | 45 days | 14 August | 15 August |
| 30 June | 90 days | 28 September | 29 September |

**Cancellation for cause.** An agreement left suspended beyond the tier's for-cause period is cancelled for cause, the unbilled remainder of the term falls due at once and the early termination fee is not charged on top.

### Figures referred to

The suspension period, reinstatement fee, expired-agreement reinstatement window and for-cause period are the tier's figures on the billing and arrears terms sheet.

superseded_clauses: Coverage is put back in force when the arrears are settled in full and the tier's reinstatement fee is charged; the suspended term is not extended, so the visits lost while suspended are not credited back.
